The measurement transducer UFC 5 drives the transmitters/receivers of the connected measurement sensor, type ALTOSONIC 5 UFS 5, make KROHNE Altometer, and processes the return signal. The transit times of both sound signals (upstream and downstream) are measured. From the time difference between the two transit times, the velocity of the liquid is determined.
